title: A 3D Cell Culture Model Identifies Wnt/β‐Catenin Mediated Inhibition of p53 as a Critical Step during Human Hepatocyte Regeneration

evidence_spans.quote: Here, a 3D spheroid model of PHH is established to study hepatocyte regeneration
human hepatocyte regeneration

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract uses a generic multi-omics label without naming molecular layers, and describes PAI1 only as a senescence-inducing target without explicitly analyzing a senescent state.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an empirical study of human hepatocyte regeneration. Aging relevance is unresolved because senescence is not itself explicitly measured, induced, reversed, or compared; the generic multi-omics wording does not establish two distinct molecular layers.

adjudication.uncertainty_reason: The abstract does not name two molecular layers and does not explicitly measure, induce, reverse, or compare cellular senescence. The experimental Wnt manipulation targets hepatocyte regeneration/proliferation rather than an established aging construct.
adjudication.concise_rationale: This is a primary empirical human-hepatocyte regeneration study. Aging relevance remains unresolved; therefore its nonrandomized Wnt activation experiment does not establish causal identification for an eligible aging construct at title/abstract stage.
